text: khemasuttaṃ [281] ekamantaṃ ṭhito kho khemo devaputto bhagavato santike imā gāthāyo abhāsi caranti bālā dummedhā amitteneva attanā karonti 1 pāpakaṃ kammaṃ yaṃ hoti kaṭukapphalaṃ na taṃ kammaṃ kataṃ sādhu yaṃ katvā anutappati yassa assumukho rodaṃ vipākaṃ paṭisevati tañca kammaṃ kataṃ sādhu yaṃ katvā nānutappati yassa patito 2 sumano vipākaṃ paṭisevati paṭikacceva 3 taṃ kayirā yaṃ jaññā hitamattano na sākaṭikacintāya mantādhīro parakkamo 4 yathā sākaṭiko pasatthaṃ 5 samaṃ hitvā mahāpathaṃ visamaṃ maggamāruyha akkhacchinnova jhāyati #1 ma. yu. karontā . 2 ma. yu. pītito . 3 sī. paṭigacceva . 4 ma. yu. #parakkame . 5 po. satthaṃ . ma. maṭṭhaṃ . yu. panthaṃ . evaṃ dhammā apakkamma adhammamanuvattiya mando maccumukhaṃ patto akkhacchinnova jhāyatīti . tatiyaṃ
